items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: She went down there the first time when she was down there to Martin Luther King‟s funeral.

ctx.x: I mean with the kinds of opportunities for a smart black lady, it‟s unique.

She went down there the first time when she was down there to Martin Luther King‟s funeral. We sent her down to the funeral and that hit her. She fell in love with Atlanta so after she got married… she‟s always had her eye on it so that‟s where they are now, in that vicinity.
